evidence.section: 4.2 Effect of tungsten on the tensile properties
evidence.quote: That is because W functioned as a solution strengthening element, will increase the resistance of dislocation motion in grains interior as well as in the lamellars interior and the friction in dislocation motion interior.

evidence.section: 4.2 Effect of tungsten on the tensile properties
evidence.quote: That the addition of tungsten reaches 1% has the most efficient refinement effect on the grain size and lamellar thickness, which maximizes the elongation.

evidence.section: 4.2 Effect of tungsten on the tensile properties
evidence.quote: The yield strength and grain size of the TiAl-based alloy are in line with Hall-Petch formula, i.e.σ0.2 =σ0+Kd-1/2 .Thus, the ductility and strength can be improved by refining grain.

evidence.section: 4.2 Effect of tungsten on the tensile properties
evidence.quote: The fine equiaxed γ grains formed in the creep process promote grain boundary sliding, which will reduce microstructure stability and make the alloy get into the tertiary creep stage prematurely.

evidence.section: 4.2 Effect of tungsten on the tensile properties
evidence.quote: The γ grains will exhibit priority deformation in the creep process and induce dynamic recrystallization.

evidence.section: 4.1 Effect of tungsten on the microstructure
evidence.quote: The precipitation process of γ phase from (α2+γ) lamellar colonies existed in the TiAl-based alloy and the growth of the lamellar are dominated by terrace-ledge-kink (TLK) model.
